title: Rare Blood Types Can Vanish From The Shelf
hook: A one-percent blood type becomes a crisis when matching donors stay home.
closing: Rare blood reaches patients only when the right donors keep showing up.
question: Do you know your blood type?

segments.say: AB-negative represents 1 percent of people. A matching donor pool can become dangerously small when supply dips.
Rh-negative covers 15 percent of people. Fewer compatible donors means shortages can hit negative types first.
Latin American donors are 53 percent O-positive. The blood shelf changes with who shows up to donate.
